symptom: CATALOG.REFS had no edge from a flow to the import or export mapping it applies and none from a mapping to its JSON structure; on FactoryManagement (11.16) 54 of 55 import mappings, 42 of 44 export mappings and 65 of 66 JSON structures had no inbound reference at all and read as dead.
cause: microflowActionRef returns one target per action and had no case for ImportXmlAction, ExportXmlAction, RestCallAction or WebServiceCallAction mappings; the mapping builders recorded SchemaSource but nothing projected it into refs.
insight: A REST or web service call names a request (export) AND a response (import) mapping, so a single-target switch cannot carry it: emit a list beside it. The mapping fields are typed model.ID but hold the qualified name (BY_NAME key), so they join to *_mappings_data.QualifiedName directly; measure that with a dangling-target query (0 here) rather than trusting the type. IMPORT_MAPPING/EXPORT_MAPPING were already in RefSourceObjectTypes (member edges), which made it look as if mappings were covered. Lint output was identical (1834 with bundled Starlark rules).
